name: SK Telecom Ventures
identity_check: SK Telecom Ventures (SKTVC) is SK Telecom's US venture arm. sktvc.com 301-redirects to skta.com, the site of SK Telecom Americas (SKTA), which calls itself the US corporate venture capital arm of SK Telecom, Santa Clara. TechCrunch uses 'SK Telecom Venture Capital (SKTVC)'. skta.com never uses the name 'SK Telecom Ventures', so the identity rests on the redirect and the TechCrunch wording. Not SK Networks, SK Square or SK hynix.

open_items: skta.com does not use the name 'SK Telecom Ventures'; the link rests on the sktvc.com redirect and TechCrunch's 'SK Telecom Venture Capital (SKTVC)'.
Stages, check size, fund and application route not stated on skta.com. Portfolio of 15 companies is shown unnamed.

GGWP Series A (April 2026) and Config seed (May 2026) come from a Caplight database page only: no amount, leads or co-investors. A Korean press report (Asiae) of the GGWP round could not be fetched (connection reset).
The Anthropic Series C date and amount come from TechCrunch's background line (May 2023, $450M led by Spark Capital); SKTVC's own cheque size is not given.
Search results also suggested SKT joined an Anthropic round in 2026 (parent, not the venture arm) and that one archive marks SK Telecom Ventures inactive; neither verified on a fetched page.
